बॉलीवुड की बेबो करीना कपूर ने कॉस्मेटिक प्रोसीजर और इंजेक्शन को लेकर एक बड़ा बयान दिया है! 💉✨

Mojo Story पर बरखा दत्त के साथ बातचीत में करीना ने साफ कहा कि वो बोटोक्स के सख्त खिलाफ हैं। करीना का मानना है कि चेहरे पर सुइयां लगवाने और सर्जरी कराने के बजाय natural therapies और सेहत का ध्यान रखना ज्यादा जरूरी है।

अभिनेत्री ने चिंता जताते हुए कहा कि आजकल यंग लड़कियां 18 या 20 साल से ज्यादा की नहीं दिखना चाहतीं, जो भयानक है। करीना ने बताया कि वो अपनी 40s की उम्र को सबसे ज्यादा एन्जॉय कर रही हैं और इस वक्त पहले से कहीं बेहतर काम कर रही हैं।

वर्कफ्रंट की बात करें तो करीना हाल ही में मेघना गुलजार की फिल्म Daayra में नजर आई थीं। इसके अलावा वो अपने पति सैफ अली खान के साथ show Koffee with Karan season 9 में भी दिखी थीं।

क्या आप भी करीना कपूर की इस natural खूबसूरती वाली बात से सहमत हैं? कमेंट्स में बताएं! 🤔💬

ctx.title: Kareena Kapoor says she is ‘very against botox’ and vouches for self preservation rather than going going under the knife
ctx.summary: Kareena Kapoor spoke about her decision to stay away from botox. She said that one cannot look 19 forever.
ctx.text:
Going under the knife to look younger might have become a norm for many in showbiz, but Kareena Kapoor doesn't prefer that. Instead, the actor has her own ways of making sure that she preserves her talent. Kareena was in conversation with Barkha Dutt for Mojo Story where she was asked for her opinion on botox and cosmetic procedures, to which the actor immediately responded by saying that she is very against botox.
The actor said, “I am very against botox, that I have been very, very honest about. I am for self-preservation in a good sense. Which is being healthy, feeling great, natural therapies. Self preservation is also preserving my talent, because that is my weapon. Taking holidays with family and friends, engaging in different things apart from just being on set is also a form of self-preservation. Rather than the needles and going under the knife. That is something that I am all for because people are forgetting that it is so important to preserve your body and mind rather than your injectibles.”
She also added, “It is terrible where young girls not wanting to look beyond 18 or 20. I am having the best time in my 40s. I have never felt better or even acted better…”
Kareena was most recently seen in Daayra, directed by Meghna Gulzar. The film marks her first on-screen collaboration with Malayalam star Prithviraj Sukumaran. Set in the world of crime and justice, the story features Prithviraj as a police inspector, while Kareena plays a character who brings an intriguing edge to the narrative. She recently made an appearance on the chat show Koffee with Karan season 9 with husband Saif Ali Khan.
Kareena got married to Saif on October 16, 2012, in Mumbai, after dating for five years. The two first grew close while shooting for Tashan (2008), directed by Vijay Krishna Acharya. The couple kept their registered marriage private, holding the ceremony at Saif’s Bandra residence before celebrating with traditional wedding functions, including a sangeet, a nikah, and a reception. They later welcomed their sons, Taimur and Jeh.
